## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2013-02-14: S-1/A Amendment No. 3 first attaches the form-of TRA (Merger) as Exhibit 10.4
- 2013-03-06: Merger TRA executed concurrent with the H&F Brewer Blocker Corp merger into APAM
- 2013-05-09: First post-IPO 10-Q files the executed Merger TRA as Exhibit 10.4

#### LIBOR replacement amendment

- 2023-08-17: First Amendment replaces the LIBOR definition with a Replacement Rate mechanism; refiled in the FY2023 10-K (2024-02-22)

## Explanation

The Merger TRA was executed on March 6, 2013 concurrent with the H&F Brewer Blocker Corp merger into APAM and APAM's Up-C IPO, with H&F Brewer AIV II as the single named beneficiary. It commits APAM to pay 85% of cash tax savings realized from the NOLs and capital losses inherited from H&F Brewer Blocker Corp plus Section 754 basis step-ups and imputed-interest deductions attributable to the merger. The August 17, 2023 First Amendment was administrative housekeeping replacing the LIBOR definition with a Replacement Rate mechanism following LIBOR cessation; no economic terms changed. The contract remains in force alongside the parallel Exchanges TRA. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
